[FMLA 11] SeriesLRC — Impedance LRC Series

Series RLC impedance at frequency f. Type f in Hz; the ROM uses 2πf, not a separate ω prompt.

Calculator scroll name: SeriesLRC. Series RLC impedance at frequency f. Type f in Hz; do not type ω into the f prompt.

formula
Z=R2+(2πfL−2πfC1​)2​

R, L, and C sit in one line. At most frequencies they fight each other and Z is large. At one special frequency (resonance) the L and C parts cancel, and only R remains.

keys
FMLA→1→1

Primary inputs: f, R, L, C (frequency in Hz, not ω).

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 1, then 1 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

  1. FMLA → 1 → 1
  2. 50 EXE 2 EXE 0.07 EXE 25 EXP (−) 6 EXE
  3. Z = 105.3518 Ω
note

SI: f in Hz, L in H, C in F, R and Z in Ω (all > 0). The formula uses 2πf; there is no ω input.
